blocks.html: Robinsons Malls celebrates the year of the Fire Rooster with a blowout of various cultural and gastronomic events for mall-goers to explore and enjoy. People are in for an Oriental-themed photo exhibits; calligraphy workshops; Chinese Food festivals and cooking demos; card and palm reading; Feng Sui consultation; and dragon dance rituals. What’s more, Robinsons Malls will transform into a Chinese village setting adorned with lanterns and prosperity trees. Visit Robinsons Malls on Chinese New Year and make it a tradition with family and friends. Watch out for Robinsons Galleria –Ortigas’ Oriental Photo Exhibit , Food Fair and Wheel of Fortune Promo from January 26-29; Robinsons Magnolia’s Chinese delicacies with Confucius Institute on January 28, Chinese art workshops on January 29, Lucky Noodle Treat Restaurant Promo from January 28-29 and Fortune Tree Photo Corner on January 15 to 31; Robinsons Place Manila’s Chinese Lantern Walkway Attraction from January 21 – 26, Chinese Selling Fair on January 21-29, and Flavors of Fortune Event from January 27-28; Robinsons Forum’s Chinese Photo Corner from January 23-29 and Calligraphy and Molding Workshop on January 28; Robinsons Metro East’s Chinese Cooking Demo on January 29; and Robinsons Town Mall Malabon’s Cooking demo, coloring activity, and selling fair on January 28. Robinsons Otis will display its photo corner from January 28 – February 4; conduct a Calligraphy workshop, Feng Shui prediction, henna art tattoo, and tarot and palm reading on January 28; and host a Chinese New Year Concert on January 29. Shoppers can try their luck in Robinsons Novaliches’ Prosperity Tree from January 20 – February 3 and its Roll of Fortune on January 28. They can also avail of Feng Sui Consultation on January 22. On the other hand, Robinsons Place Las Piñas will host a cooking demo show on January 28. Mallers can look forward to Robinsons Place Malolos’ Confucius Institute Cultural Show on January 28; Robinsons Place Pangasinan’s Pick Your Luck promo from January 23 - 31 , Calligraphy Art and Card Reading activities on January 27-28, and Chinese Culture and Art Exhibit on January 23-28; Robinsons Starmill’s Feng Shui consultation with Dr. John Tan from January 29-31 and Chinese Horoscope Display from January 21-31; and Robinsons Angeles’ Feng Shui consultation with Dr. John Tan on January 25-27 and Chinese Horoscope Display on January 21-31. Usher in the year of the rooster with Robinsons Place Gen. Trias’ Chinese Cooking Show with Kiddie Workshop on January 22 with various selling activities and Feng Shui consultation on January 28; Robinsons Place Dasma, Robinsons Place Imus and Summit Ridge Promenade’s Chinese New Year Display on January 20 to 31, Chinese Food Festival and Ang Pao Tree Promo from January 27 - 29; Robinsons Sta. Rosa’s Fortune Tree from January 21-31; and Robinsons Place Lipa’s Wheel of Fortune promo, Chinese Mask Making and Feng Shui consultation from January 27-28. The Chinese New Year celebration will not be complete without the Dragon and Lion Dance. Witness this beautiful tradition at the following Robinsons Malls- January 27 at Robinsons Magnolia, 10 am; Robinsons Sta. Rosa, 1 pm; Robinsons Town Mall Malabon, 10 am; Robinsons Forum, 10 am, Robinsons Town Mall Los Baños, 10 am; and Robinsons Place Lipa, 2 pm. You may also visit Robinsons Galleria, 10 am; Robinsons Metro East, 10 am; Robinsons Cainta, 3:30 pm; Robinsons Place Las Piñas, 10 am; Robinsons Novaliches, 3pm; Robinsons Starmills, 3 pm; Robinsons Angeles, 4 pm; Robinsons Place Malolos, 4pm; Robinsons Place Gen. Trias, 3:30pm; Robinsons Luisita, 1pm; and Robinsons Place Pangasinan, 10 am. You may still catch the Dragon and Lion Dance on January 29 at Robinsons Place Ilocos, 10 am; Robinsons Place Antipolo, 10 am; Robinsons Place Manila, 10 am; and Robinsons Otis, 10 am.
